_comment: Map levels for the v3 drill-down on a council design code page.
Settlement boundaries are real: planning.data.gov.uk built-up-area dataset (entity numbers given).
Place type zones are INDICATIVE: the design code does not map place types, so they are scaled copies of each built-up area, for illustrating the interaction only.
The example site is ILLUSTRATIVE (image from the Figma design); app/routes/v3.js places it inside whichever indicative place type is chosen.
Built by build_levels.py from the built-up-area entities that intersect East Riding of Yorkshire (entity 8600010).
